title: Private-network discovery: only ever dialling out
lede: A workload connector and scanner reach agents inside your own network and cloud accounts (Bedrock, AgentCore, Lex). The connector polls outbound through your proxy; nothing dials in. The lab makes no network call. Ping release claim, UNVERIFIED on our tenant. Simulated.

nodes.label: Agents in your network (Bedrock, AgentCore, Lex)

edges.label: poll, outbound; findings leave the same way
each agent stored with its scanner location

steps.title: Poll out
steps.what: The connector opens the connection itself, outbound, through your proxy. Findings travel back out the same way.

steps.title: Forwarded
steps.what: The proxy passes the poll to the controller.

steps.title: Work in the reply
steps.what: Scan work comes back in the reply to that poll, not as a new inbound connection.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.what: The connector gives it to the scanner, which holds the cloud access.

steps.title: Scan
steps.what: The scanner reads the agents inside your network.

steps.title: Recorded
steps.what: Each agent is stored with the scanner location: an AWS account, Azure subscription or GCP project.
